description:
Open the dataset '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/BFI25.csv' in Jamovi. Create 5 new Computed Variables representing the Big Five personality traits by calculating the MEAN of the respective items for each trait: 'Agreeableness' (A1-A5), 'Conscientiousness' (C1-C5), 'Extraversion' (E1-E5), 'Neuroticism' (N1-N5), and 'Openness' (O1-O5). Ensure the 'gender' variable is set to the 'Nominal' measure type. 

Then, perform a Binomial Logistic Regression to predict 'gender' using the 5 new personality variables as Covariates. In the analysis options, enable 'Classification table' and 'AUC' (Area Under the Curve) under the Prediction/Model Performance section.

Save the Jamovi project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/BFI_Gender_Prediction.omv'. Finally, create a text file at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/model_accuracy_report.txt' and report the AUC and Accuracy values found in the results, formatted exactly as:
AUC: <value>
Accuracy: <value>
(e.g., AUC: 0.654, Accuracy: 0.621).
